Spec: `specs/workspace-sync/spec.md` gains a "The lease invariant" section recording how the connector now keeps pool leases and synced workspace records consistent (mngr-internal#642): the lease grant writes a metadata-only ACTIVE record stub in the lease transaction, every release path retires the record (tombstoning a client-written one, deleting a never-written stub) in the same transaction as the `removing` flip, hard record deletes are refused (409 `lease_active`) while the workspace still holds a lease, and an hourly connector sweep releases leases whose tombstone is past the grace window while only alarming on record-less leases.

Spec only -- the implementation is described in the `remote_service_connector`, `minds`, `minds_admin`, and `mngr_imbue_cloud` entries for this branch.
